item.text: {"iteration":2,"pcvs":[{"name":"prompt_length","expression":"len(prompt_token_ids) if prompt_token_ids is not None else 0","rationale":"Models the cost of copying the prompt list."},{"name":"single_token_prompt","expression":"int(prompt_token_ids is not None and len(prompt_token_ids) == 1)","rationale":"Separates the first observed state, which has substantially higher constructor cost."},{"name":"two_token_prompt","expression":"int(prompt_token_ids is not None and len(prompt_token_ids) == 2)","rationale":"Separates the second observed state, which also has elevated cost."},{"name":"periodic_elevated_state","expression":"int(prompt_token_ids is not None and len(prompt_token_ids) % 7 == 5)","rationale":"Tests the shared excess cost observed at prompt lengths 5 and 12."}],"hypothesis":"The fixed workload exhibits a nearly constant baseline, two initial elevated states, and additional excess cost at lengths 5 and 12.
